name: Patellar Sleeve Fracture
definition: Pediatric avulsion fracture in which cartilage and a small bony fragment are stripped from the patella, often disrupting the extensor mechanism.

investigations.principle: Radiographs may underestimate the cartilage component; MRI/ultrasound can clarify.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury, deformity or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Displaced injuries often require surgical repair.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu-bhagna/Snayu phenotype may be documented after modern assessment.

patientEducation.summary: Pediatric avulsion fracture in which cartilage and a small bony fragment are stripped from the patella, often disrupting the extensor mechanism.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
